# Download instructions

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> If your browser or operating system warns about the download, choose keep or download anyway *only if you trust this release.*\*

- **Windows users**: download the Windows installer (.exe) `NCEA GUI-Windows-{version}-Setup.exe` 

- **Linux users**: download the AppImage `NCEA GUI-Linux-{version}.AppImage`

> On Linux, you may need to make the AppImage executable if your system does not do that automatically, then run it.

## Support

If the app does not start or the download looks wrong, open an issue in the repository with the release version and your OS.
